source: assignment_latents in phase5t represent.py, used by Phase-5Y RelationalSetScorer
old_pooling_equation: triple_i = concat(H_UAV_i, H_Buoy_{a_i}, H_edge_{i,a_i}); z_selected = sum_i(triple_i * 1[a_i != idle]) / count(selected); pair_ij = concat(symmetric H_UU_ij, interact(concat(edge_i, edge_j))) for both selected; z_pairs = mean(pair_ij); z_post = concat(z_selected, z_pairs, z_global); head_input = concat(z_post, z_REP_TEMP)

aggregated_before_binding_survives.buoy_slice_of_z_selected: sum of H_Buoy over the selected buoy set. The UAV that chose the buoy cancels out of this slice.
aggregated_before_binding_survives.uav_slice_of_z_selected: sum of H_UAV over the selected UAV set. The target cancels out of this slice.
aggregated_before_binding_survives.h_uu: UAV-UAV embedding does not depend on the assigned buoys.

still_carries_correspondence: The edge slice is sum_i H_edge_{i,a_i}. It is the only assignment-specific term that sees the matched pair, and Phase-5Z showed that the following mean makes its residual small.

replacement.pair_first: pair_i = concat(H_UAV_i, H_Buoy_or_zero, edge_or_zero, broadcast REP, broadcast TEMP, idle_flag)
replacement.phi: Linear -> SiLU -> Linear, shared across UAVs
replacement.pool_second: z_assignment = mean_i phi(pair_i), including idle tokens
replacement.rep_temp_note: Frozen REP and TEMP are assignment-level. They are broadcast onto every UAV token because the frozen feature code has no per-UAV REP or TEMP vector.
